I'm a text-based AI assistant, so I can only communicate through typed text. I don't have the ability to:

- Hear audio from a microphone
- Speak through speakers
- Process voice in real-time

**Alternatives you could consider:**

1. **Voice-to-text** - Use your device's speech-to-text feature to dictate messages to me, then read my responses
2. **Text-to-speech** - Use a screen reader or TTS tool to have my responses read aloud to you
3. **Voice-enabled AI assistants** - Products like Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, or voice-enabled versions of other AI tools offer spoken conversation

Is there anything I can help you with through text?
